notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/4c73ee005b3185055d61869ebadc1bcd0d5d5b98.jpg"][/img]
Hello Survivors,

This is the DARKEST DAYS.

A non-maintenance patch will be applied on September 24, Wednesday, to resolve some in-game issues and implement improvements.
Please check the details below.


[/p][h3][b]■ Patch Schedule[/b][/h3][p]- At approximately 23:30 (UTC) on Wednesday, September 24

[/p][h3][b]■ Patch Details[/b][/h3][p]- Rootland ranking score calculation adjusted
　ㄴ To strengthen farming and PvP-focused play in Rootland, experience points will be lowered while points for defeating survivors and searching furniture in buildings will be increased.
　ㄴ Experience points earned from zombie kills and securing building safety will be decreased.
　ㄴ Points earned from killing Survivors/Vagabonds will be increased.
　ㄴ Points earned from \[Searching] furniture in buildings will be increased.

[/p][h3][b]■ Notes[/b][/h3][p]- Those currently in the game are advised to log out and reconnect to the game for proper application of the patch.
- On mobile, please go to Settings ▶ Account ▶ Return to Title Screen to exit and reconnect to the game.


Thank you.

DARKEST DAYS Team[/p]

notes.title: [Update] Thursday, September 18 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/7844841adac1b964bcf0bc6922d22f1d761c72a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the DARKEST DAYS, Trust No One![/p][p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p]This is the DARKEST DAYS[/p][p][/p][p]We would like to share the patch notes for the version update on September 18 (Thu).[/p][p]Please check the details of this update below.[/p][p][/p][p]※ All screenshots and images were taken in a test environment and may differ from the live server version.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Version Info[/b][/h3][p]-	PC: 0.22.3[/p][p]-	Mobile: 0.22.3[/p][p]※ This is a data-only patch and does not require a separate new build.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Patch Schedule[/b][/h3][p]- September 18 (Thu) @ 00:00 UTC[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ New Additions[/b][/h3][p][b]\[New Pet – Alpaca][/b][/p][p]- A new pet, Alpaca, has been added.[/p][p]- The Alpaca pet can be found in Shop > Pets.[/p][p]- This pet can only be purchased once per character.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/c86faf0fc542f2bf0335a133fd90765bea150b5e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[New Recruitment Service Resident – Luna Bloody][/b][/p][p]- You can now recruit Luna Bloody by going to Shop > Recruitment.[/p][p]- Luna Bloody was previously only obtainable from Community Pass Season 1[/p][p]- This resident can only be recruited once per character.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/e6dbcaeda3b2f8d61da87aabe0ffa440b7c73461.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[New Equipment – Hektor5A5 & Street Armor][/b][/p][p]- New firearms and armor have been added.[/p][p]- Hektor5A5: a compact and lightweight submachine gun with immense firepower.[/p][p]- 4 variants of the Hektor5A5 have been added, from N to SSR grade.[/p][p]- Street-themed SSR armor has been added (4 pieces).[/p][p]- These new items can be obtained through in-game drops or Pickup Lucky Boxes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/9fbc7ce213c09096398a5d4bce54880c62d75963.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Hektor5A5 & Street Armor Rate-Up! Pickup Lucky Box][/b][/p][p]- To celebrate the new equipment release, the Hektor5A5 & Street Armor Rate-Up Pickup Lucky Box is now available.[/p][p]- This Lucky Box is available only for a limited time until 11/05 (Wed) 11:59 UTC.[/p][p]- You can obtain the Hektor5A5 and Street Armor at increased rates.[/p][p]- Available at Shop > Lucky Box > Pickup Lucky Box.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/af75cf0cafd16ebcc7c5861fc00ca2c7baf1b537.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[New Packages – Street Theme Package 1 & 2][/b][/p][p]- To celebrate the release of the Street Armor, two new limited packages will also be available.[/p][p]- The packages will be available only for a limited time until 11/05 (Wed) 11:59 UTC.[/p][p]- Available at Shop > Packages > Limited-Time Packages.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[New Popup Packages – Special Resident Growth Packages 1/2/3/4][/b][/p][p]- New popup packages designed to help resident growth have been added.[/p][p]- These packages (1/2/3/4) will appear once per account, when a resident first reaches levels 15/20/25/30 after September 18.[/p][p]- Each popup package is available for 12 hours only, and cannot be purchased once it disappears.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Major Improvements[/b][/h3][p][b]\[Lonetree Tunnel Rewards Increased][/b][/p][p]- New popup packages designed to help resident growth have been added.[/p][p]- Mid-grade Facility Blueprints can be acquired from the initial clearing of Lonetree Tunnel stages 14 ~ 29[/p][p]- High-grade Forge Blueprints can be acquired from the initial clearing of Lonetree Tunnel stages 30 & 35.[/p][p]- Top-grade Forge Blueprints can be acquired from the initial clearing of Lonetree Tunnel stages 40, 45, 50[/p][p]- Low ~ High-grade Facility Blueprint drops have been added for repeat clearing of Lonetree Tunnel[/p][p]ㄴThese blueprint drops will start from stage 10 in 5-stage intervals[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/c34ed3d308619ee41a0fb5a10c02512985ea4afc.png"][/img]* Survivors who have cleared Lonetree Tunnel before the update (9/18) will be compensated retroactively based on the stages they cleared.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Lonetree Tunnel Deadite Balance Adjustment][/b][/p][p]- More Deadites can now be acquired by killing zombies during Lonetree Tunnel gameplay.[/p][p]- Deadite rewards for completing the 1st and 2nd Defense Waves have been increased.[/p][p]- Stronger zombies (Elite, Epic, etc.) will now drop more Deadite.[/p][p]- Removed low-utility A-TAS supplies: Firecracker and Alarm Bell.[/p][p]* The team is currently working on improving the Lonetree Tunnel to make it more enticing and worthwhile for Survivors. With the first set of updates, the Deadite balance and overall rewards have been improved.[/p][p]* Additional improvements are scheduled for the next update to readjust the entry conditions of Lonetree Tunnel.[/p][p]* In the future, Lonetree Tunnel will be easier to play daily with more meaningful rewards. We hope you look forward to the continual improvements and updates to the content.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p]- Fixed an issue where the icons for quest items “Infection Cure Shot S”, “Defibrillator S”, and “Dan’s Infection Cure Shot” were displayed incorrectly[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the options for N-grade armor (Sporty Short-Sleeved Hoodie) were applied incorrectly.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where 5 types of N-grade armor (Canvas Snapback, Ribbon Boater Hat, Newsboy Cap, Cotton Bucket Hat, Stitched Cap) were acquired as non-tradeable items.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the quest clear reward for resident Lola Sweet’s “Vlog Shooting Spot” were not sent[/p][p]* Survivors who did not receive the daily quest rewards before the patch will have the missing rewards sent after the patch.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Additional Improvements[/b][/h3][p]- Increased player bag capacity from 24 to 36 slots.[/p][p]- CS-23, Pilot Armor has been added to Advanced/Event/Normal Lucky Boxes.[/p][p]- Story Quests “Fully Prepared” and “Check Surroundings” will now progress sequentially.[/p][p]- Weapon reward for story quest “Survival” updated from Rick 357 (R) → Krinkov-47 (R)[/p][p]- Weapon reward for story quest “Useful Intel” updated from OK Coach Gun → ALPHA-12[/p][p]- Improved the convenience in early Story Quests related to talking with NPCs and moving to quest areas.[/p][p]- Reduced construction and upgrade time for shelter facilities from 90 seconds → 10 seconds.[/p][p]- Adjusted daily quest objectives for “Vidagua Rescue Team”, “Endless Knowledge”, and “Fossil Excavation” to lower the clear difficulty level.[/p][p]- Increased the exploration success rate for Ambulance in \[Shelter] – \[Exploration Storage] – \[Resident Exploration] from 1% → 5%.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Please refer to these latest updates when playing the game.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p]DARKEST DAYS Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: [August 29 Korean AMA and Roadmap Update Q&A]
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/7844841adac1b964bcf0bc6922d22f1d761c72a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p][/p][p]This is the DARKEST DAYS.[/p][p][/p][p]As we have previously done, we compiled a list of questions from the community, along with answers that were shared during a special live broadcast held on August 28th.[/p][p][/p][p]Many questions were asked about the recent updates, as well as future game updates.  [/p][p]Please check below for the list of questions and answers.[/p][p]As always, we will do our best to listen to the voices of the survivors to create a more enjoyable game for all![/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What was the development intent for Harsh Winter Bielli Island?[/b][/p][p]A. Harsh Winter Bielli Island is currently the most difficult region to date, and party play is recommend for all survivors except maybe the top-tier players. In Harsh Winter Bielli Island, blueprints for SSR equipment can drop, allowing players to collect fragments and craft the equipment themselves.[/p][p]With this region's introduction, the leveling up of your Shelter will also be made easier through this and future updates.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What is the purpose of existing SSR equipment blueprints (pre-update)?[/b][/p][p]A. We plan to introduce a 1:1 exchange feature for existing completed blueprints, so players can craft the equipment they want. We apologize for not informing everyone of this earlier.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What is the purpose of introducing party member NPC AI?[/b][/p][p]A. Many survivors requested improvements to the Resident AI, especially regarding unintended aggression from party members.[/p][p]To address this, we added the ability to specify the combat behavior of resident NPCs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Please review the Survivor Levels[/b][/p][p]A. The new season officially kicked off with a lower difficulty level than the previous one.[/p][p]In the latest season, you can acquire the Racing Suit costume.[/p][p]The team was particularly surprised and grateful to see a player reach level 110, which exceeds our expectations. We considered reaching level 80 already a challenging milestone, so we thank the survivor for achieving level 110.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can additional survivor level rewards be added?[/b][/p][p]A. Since survivor level reflects combat-oriented growth, we are not planning to add additional stats.[/p][p]However, we are open to discussing more ideas for enhancing or adding honorary rewards in the future.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What is the Sheltic Bot system?[/b][/p][p]A. We added a “Sheltic Bot” feature to assist new survivors.[/p][p]However, it may not provide correct answers to all questions, but we plan to continually update and expand its knowledge based on common inquiries.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Were equipment drop rates reduced?[/b][/p][p]A. While new items may affect drop rates for existing items, there are no changes that significantly alter gameplay.[/p][p]Our development philosophy is to enhance the fun of farming equipment within the game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can vehicles sent on explorations be used?[/b][/p][p]A. In the upcoming October update, all vehicles can be summoned and used regardless of exploration status.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What was the intent behind the party system improvements?[/b][/p][p]A. We added the ability to create a party and invite others before joining a multiplayer region. Also, additional buffs are provided to encourage party play.[/p][p]Lonetree Tunnel has also been improved to function better with the party system.[/p][p]Players can continue or retry runs more easily after success or failure in Lonetree Tunnel.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Are there any adjustments being made to gun attributes?[/b][/p][p]A. The roadmap initially planned a skill revamp in November, but we feel that the balancing of the guns should be addressed first.[/p][p]Therefore, we will proceed with a rebalancing of the guns before the skill revamp.[/p][p]Updated specs and plans for upcoming updates will be shared soon.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. How is the party distribution calculated?[/b][/p][p]A. Item distribution depends on the region, while experience is calculated by distance traveled.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. The background of Harsh Winter Bielli Island appears foggy[/b][/p][p]A, We will review this internally and improve it as needed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Twilight Holitore seems to give more XP (than Harsh Winter Bielli Island)[/b][/p][p]A. Harsh Winter Bielli Island provides more XP than Twilight Holitore.[/p][p]Difficulty and hunting conditions will vary, so please consider these factors when trying to level up.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. How is the updated auto-move feature?[/b][/p][p]A. With the auto-move update, the walking seems okay, but driving experience has received negative feedback.[/p][p]We will review this for potential improvements.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can the hunting ground conflict in Harsh Winter Bielli Island be improved?[/b][/p][p]A. The max player count was reduced to 16 for the region, but we may adjust if survivors still face difficulties.[/p][p]A dynamic conflict system is being considered in which the area is temporarily considered a conflict zone if players continuously interfere with each other when hunting and looting.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can weapon stats and attributes be shown?[/b][/p][p]A. This will be improved with the upcoming gun attribute updates.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Any plans to improve the Resident Exploration?[/b][/p][p]A. Some reworks are being considered to fix frequent bugs and prevent the monotonous feel of map areas.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What are the planned updates for October?[/b][/p][p]A. The planned updates are as follows:[/p][p]- Guild Shelter, Guild Conquest, Guild Missions[/p][p]- Halloween season event[/p][p]- SSR firearms: choice of scope or iron sight[/p][p]- Item lock feature[/p][p]- Vehicles sent on exploration can be used[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can XP be displayed as a percentage?[/b][/p][p]A. We'll take this into consideration.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can multiple attachments be used per facility?[/b][/p][p]A. Currently, only one attachment per facility is allowed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can enhancement and resident exploration be used in multiplayer regions?[/b][/p][p]A. As of now, facilities are intended for use at the player’s own shelter, but we will review potential adjustments.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Upgrade is too difficult. How about having Blessed Upgrade Boxes?[/b] [/p][p]A. Discussions are ongoing about preventing level loss during upgrade failures. There is some talk about introducing items to prevent downgrade incase of failure. Although the introduction of such item/system is under discussion, if it is introduced, it will be obtainable from loot or drops rather than as a purchasable item.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can the Exchange be filtered by level?[/b][/p][p]A. The feature is currently planned but not yet implemented. We apologize for the delay.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can a hotkey be added to select specific items when opening Rootland boxes?[/b][/p][p]A. We understand the need and will review it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. A skill preset feature seems to be needed.[/b][/p][p]A. Skill tree presets will be added alongside gun rebalancing in the late November update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What is the official release schedule?[/b][/p][p]A. We believe there are still issues and improvements to make before the official release.[/p][p]The release will proceed once current problems are sufficiently addressed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. The penalties in the Conflict Zones seem to be insufficient.[/b][/p][p]A. When defeated in conflict zones, the result is loss of items. [/p][p]We will consider added rewards for victories as well based on feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Are Lonetree Tunnel rebalancing updates planned?[/b][/p][p]A. Currently, there the top survivors are attempting Stage 30. [/p][p]Adjustments in difficult, first-clear rewards, repeatable rewards, and balancing item acquisition to allow better use of consumables and deployable items. are currently in the works.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can the party item distribution for R~SR be adjusted?[/b][/p][p]A. notes.title: [Update] Wednesday, August 27th – Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/7844841adac1b964bcf0bc6922d22f1d761c72a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p][/p][p]This is the DARKEST DAYS.[/p][p] [/p][p]The patch notes for the latest updated version on Wednesday, 8/27 are here! [/p][p]※ Please note that screenshots and images were taken in a test environment, and some changes may occur when applied to the live server. [/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Version Info[/b][/h3][p]- PC:  0.22.1[/p][p]- Mobile: 0.22.1[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ New Content[/b][/h3][p][b]\[New Multi-player Region – Harsh Winter Bielli Island][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/ba6f2c0bca6959fce0a87f848e2a6527c20d659b.png"][/img]- Added a new multi-player region: Harsh Winter Bielli Island.[/p][p]- Higher chance to obtain SSR-grade materials that were difficult to acquire in existing regions.[/p][p]- Obtain newly added SSR-grade equipment blueprint fragments.[/p][p]- Craft SSR-grade equipment blueprints at the Forge using the fragments.[/p][p]- New region available from Character Level 40, with Level 46 zombies roaming the area.[/p][p]- As it is the most challenging region in the game, party play is recommended.[/p][p]- Harsh Winter Bielli Island will be PvE only with no conflict zones in the map.[/p][p]※ For those who have the previous High-performance and High-Quality SSR equipment blueprints in their inventory, we are preparing a system that will allow you to exchange them for the updated SSR blueprint of the equipment you want in the future. [/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Party Resident AI Behavior Selection System Added][/b][/p][p]- Assign AI behavioral patterns to any resident that joins your party:  Attack / Defense / Standby[/p][p]- ‘Attack’ will prioritize attacking any target that is near the player.[/p][p]- ‘Defense’ will cause the resident to stay behind the player and attack the same target the player attacks.[/p][p]- ‘Standby’ will have the resident follow the player, but not attack any nearby targets.[/p][p]- Residents in the party will also use consumables as needed regardless of the AI behavior you select.[/p][p]- The AI behavior pattern can be checked in the party info.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/3657474c357c22bcbe6db27bb7eda1e4af5ad843.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[New AI Chatbot – Sheltic Bot][/b][/p][p]- Sheltic Bot AI chat system added.[/p][p]- The bot will automatically answer various gameplay questions from survivors.[/p][p]* This feature is constantly in development and may occasionally provide incorrect or no answer at all.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[New Resident – Lola Sweet / Community Pass: Season 4][/b][/p][p]- Lola Sweet is an influencer with more than 980,000 followers on the social media platform, Like It.[/p][p]- Known for her dance challenges and vlogs, she continued to spread positivity even after the shutdown of Like It because of the outbreak.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/ed882ef9d63b2ab1976e6fea93c3cec8e0532d18.png"][/img][/p][p]- Lola Sweet can be unlocked by reaching Level 1 in the latest season of the Community Pass – Season 4.[/p][p]- Lola Sweet’s special costume can be acquired when reaching Level 40 in the Community Pass.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/3b4fc84f7c0a4b97799cd5c5128d206b8de8bb99.png"][/img]- Community Pass available in Shop → Packages → Community Pass.[/p][p]- Community Pass UI improved and missions revamped.[/p][p]- Community Pass can be purchased once per character.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[New Survivor Level Season](~25/10/16)[/b][/p][p]- A new Survivor Level Season will start.[/p][p]- Updated with reduced XP requirements for faster leveling.[/p][p]- Survivor Ability Board adjusted with rewards for reaching level 40/80.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/c3257f787966773229c791a2d38b34667341f923.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[New Vehicle – Police Car][/b][/p][p]- The new vehicle ‘Police Car’ will be faster and more durable than existing vehicles, allowing it to be used universally in all types of situations.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/3324c9f2b309be5ea3ab304519827cf6ed0fadc4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[New Popup Packages – All-in-One Survival Packages 1/2/3][/b][/p][p]- These new pop-up packages will help survivors grow early in the game (Before Level 40).[/p][p]- The All-in-One Survival Packages 1/2/3 will pop up when you achieve the following levels for all characters created from August 28th – Level 16 / 26 / 36.[/p][p]- Pop-up packages will be available for a limited time of 12 hours and they cannot be purchased once the pop-up disappears.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[New Limited-Time Package - Facility Blueprint Package (Until Oct 16, 2025)][/b][/p][p]- Limited package will contain high-grade facility blueprints.[/p][p]- Available in Shop → Packages → Limited-Time Packages.[/p][p]- Package will have a purchase limit of 10 times per character.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[New Monthly Package - (1+1) Resident Level-Up Package 1/2/3][/b][/p][p]- Newest Monthly Package will double the rewards compared to previous Resident Level-Up Packages[/p][p]- Available in Shop → Packages → Limited-Time Packages.[/p][p]- Package will have a purchase limit of 10 times per character. (Resets on the 1st of each month at 11:59 UTC)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Key Improvements[/b][/h3][p][b]\[Party Creation Improvements][/b][/p][p]- You can now pre-assemble parties before entering multi-player regions.[/p][p]- Invite friends, guild members, or other survivors to your party.[/p][p]- Open recruitment function allows automatic party formations according to desired level/combat conditions set.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/f60734e857c3a606dcb133cc10068675ba19fd74.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Party Exclusive Enhancements][/b][/p][p]- Party Enhancement Effects added and applied to parties.[/p][p]- Party exclusive enhancements increase the attack power and movement speed of survivors in the same party when attacking zombies.[/p][p]- Party Exclusive Enhancements apply only to survivors and not residents.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/d5d73bee250993e1b13a5d5cf4e5aae6bda6da60.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Party Loot Distribution Updated][/b][/p][p]- Distribution of XP, goods, and items obtained through party play improved.[/p][p]- A certain amount of Milla and character XP acquired from killing zombies and securing buildings will be distributed to party members within the same area.[/p][p]- If a party member is in a different region than the rest of the party and cannot receive distribution rewards, an icon will be displayed in the Party Info.[/p][p]  ex) If a party member is in ‘Twilight Holitore – Santa Cuenca’, they cannot receive distributed items obtained in ‘Twilight Holitore - Bendiciora’.[/p][p]  ex) Even if your resident is in the same area as your party members, if your character is not in the same area, it cannot receive the distributed rewards.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/9a216cbdc340ce5924a02fd853a4557615546777.png"][/img][/p][p]- If only your party is present in a region when a building is secured, all items inside the building will be automatically searched.[/p][p]- Items acquired through auto search will be distributed between party members through a lottery.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/0a2ada027a6e2ae31482bcc04a45c4e861953625.png"][/img][/p][p]- Items acquired from opening item boxes will be distributed to party members through a lottery. [/p][p]- If the inventory of the party member who wins the item lottery is full, the item will drop on the ground with ownership remaining with the winner.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/d38d4fb92fb0b018cec4c97121d4303f138ffd40.png"][/img][/p][p]- If a party member obtains an SSR-grade item, a special effect will be shown and the acquisition will be announced in the party chat.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Multiplayer Mode UI Improvements][/b][/p][p]- On the Multiplayer World Map, Conflict Zones and Peace Zones will be displayed with different icons.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/82dfc7785f7917e93ac32f4998b217cbfb5a596c.png"][/img]- The image of Twilight Holitore displayed on the region information download screen has been updated.[/p][p]- The mode description in the Twilight Holitore entry information screen has been revised, and facility blueprints will now be displayed as rewards.[/p][p]- If the equipped weapon’s score is lower than the recommended weapon score for the multiplayer region chosen, a party recommendation notice will now be displayed on the multiplayer entry screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/4d56a8d0be903030ed4667aaed24a4d0275f2f1d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Auto-Move Feature Added][/b][/p][p]-  A new function has been added that will allow your character to automatically move to a destination that is set with “Marker” or “Track”. [/p][p]- The character will automatically follow the guided route shown to the destination.[/p][p]- If two or more destinations are set, the character will automatically move to the destination marked with “Marker”.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/416dccd11791cee619db84e23f37041f8f16a0aa.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Contaminated Flower Battle Balance Improvements][/b][/p][p]- The combat balance when fighting a Contaminated Flower has been adjusted to improve the combat experience.[/p][p]- Headshot zones have been added to the Contaminated Flower and Contaminated Roots. [/p][p](Left – Normal Hit // Right - Headshot)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/dda6606c5c6b85fc4bbceaa251d6411a4be8c755.png"][/img][/p][p]- A larger variety of zombies such as Normal Zombies, Howlers, and Ranged Zombies will now spawn more frequently from Contaminated Roots.[/p][p]- Destroying Contaminated Roots has become more important in battles with the Contaminated Flower.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/19b2cd1e4dc34cad4a64a45e3720e676b7f75707.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Lonetree Tunnel Auto Combat Feature Added][/b][/p][p]- When replaying a Lonetree Tunnel section that has previously been cleared, the Auto Combat function can be used. [/p][p]- In Auto Combat, the character will behave like an NPC and defend the base.[/p][p]- If you disconnect or remain inactive for more than 10 seconds while replaying a cleared Lonetree Tunnel section, the Auto Combat will activate.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Lonetree Tunnel Replay Feature Added][/b][/p][p]- A new feature has been added that allows you to continue playing the next section of Lonetree Tunnel with the current party or replay a failed section.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Higher-Grade Equipment Notification Added][/b][/p][p]- When acquiring higher-level or higher-grade equipment, a \[Can equip higher-grade/unmounted gear] notification will appear.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/2d05aaee029fb5d1c21a59736dadd77c5f45df99.png"][/img][/p][p]- Changes in combat power \[increase/decrease] caused by equipping new items will now be displayed.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Additional Improvements[/b][/h3][p]- Tips have been added to the loading screen.[/p][p]- For items sold in single quantities, you can now purchase them directly without selecting the amount.[/p][p]- The default purchase quantity for stackable items has been set to 1.[/p][p]- Sprinting can now be done immediately from a stationary state.[/p][p]- The rank rewards screen has been improved.[/p][p]- Certain pop-up UIs now display confirm/cancel hotkeys.[/p][p]- The HUD chat window can now always be shown or hidden via chat settings.[/p][p]- Remaining entry times for other multiplayer regions such as “Dusk Garden” and “Rootland” are now displayed within the multiplayer regions.[/p][p]- Tommy SSR-grade weapon model quality has been improved.[/p][p]- The maximum number of “Anilium Fragments”, “Mid-grade Materials”, and “High-grade Materials” that can be crafted at once in the Force has been increased.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Other Adjustments[/b][/h3][p]- With the end of the summer event, the Starfish currency and shop will be removed.[/p][p]- The Sheltic score gained has been increased in proportion to the boosted attack/defense stats of SSR equipment from the previous update. [/p][p]- Rewards dropped by Lv. 40+ Titans and Contaminated Flowers has been increased.[/p][p]- Experience gained from killing zombies higher than Lv. 41 and securing buildings has been adjusted.[/p][p]- The unlocking for certain SR-grade or higher ranged weapon blueprints has been updated to unlock earlier.[/p][p]- A new free shop item, “Daily Growth Supply” has been added.[/p][p]- Chance for residents to acquire higher-grade blueprints during exploration has been increased.[/p][p]- Reward history for “7-Day Login Event” and “28-Day Login Event” has been reset.[/p][p]- Missions and rewards for the Level-Up Mission Event has been enhanced.[/p][p]- The number of kill logs displayed on the screen and its display duration has been increased.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p]- Fixed an issue where terrain and background objects displayed abnormally.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where destroyed objects reappeared when viewed from a distance.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue on mobile where background lighting continued to display.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where certain texts were not translated in the Graphics Settings screen.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the UI appeared too small when entering via the tablet Exploration Storage icon.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the MG240 icon appeared the same regardless of grade.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the SPR gun notes.title: Developer Letter: 100 Days of Global Open Beta
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/7844841adac1b964bcf0bc6922d22f1d761c72a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p][/p][p]It has now been 100 days since we launched the Open Beta for DARKEST DAYS.[/p][p]To reflect on the journey so far and share our direction for the future, we’ve prepared a special developer’s letter.[/p][p][/p][p]\[Please see below for the full letter][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p][p][/p][p]We have also prepared a special coupon to celebrate the 100-Day Anniversary![/p][p]More details about the coupon and event will be released in a separate post.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1548520/view/544490453586673847?l=english" style="button"][b]\[100-Day Open Beta Anniversary Event Link][/b][/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]\[100-Day Anniversary Special Coupon][/b][/h3][p]Coupon Code: DD100DAY[/p][p]Redemption Period: 2025.08.01 ~ 2025.08.28[/p][p]Reward Items: 30 Event Lucky Coupons / 300,000 Milla / 3 Resident Combat Manuals[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Survivors.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s already been 100 days since we welcomed you to our open beta.[/p][p]We’re thrilled that so many of you have joined us, sharing your feedback and support to help shape this game together.[/p][p][/p][p]Looking back, there were certainly areas where we fell short.[/p][p]But the entire development team, including myself, has worked hard to quickly address issues and improve.[/p][p]In this letter, we’d like to reflect on what has changed over the past 100 days and share what direction we plan to head next.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Key Changes Over the Past 100 Days[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Roadmap Release[/b][/p][p]Based on feedback collected through the official community and internal discussions, we released a Trello-style roadmap that allows anyone to easily track current and upcoming development plans.[/p][p]Each item is categorized by stages such as “Under Review,” “In Progress,” “Planned,” and “Live,” so Survivors can check the development status at a glance.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Resident Expedition Content Added[/b][/p][p]We introduced Resident Expedition, a new content feature focused on Resident growth.[/p][p]Players can form an expedition by combining vehicles and Residents they own, then explore a tile-based board using fuel.[/p][p]During exploration, various events such as battles, rewards, and buffs occur.[/p][p]Winning battles grants valuable loot and Resident EXP, adding the fun of collection and progression.[/p][p][/p][p]While the current reception has been mixed, we’re planning a major revamp to better meet your expectations.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Introducing Survivor Level System[/b][/p][p]The new Survivor Level system allows growth beyond the previous level cap.[/p][p]Players can earn EXP by killing zombies, capturing buildings, and completing quests.[/p][p]Each time your Survivor Level increases, you receive points to invest in one of 120 upgrade nodes to upgrade abilities.[/p][p]This enables you to create a custom growth path tailored to your playstyle.[/p][p]We are actively collecting feedback on the season-based system as well and will continue improving it to address your concerns.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Guild System[/b][/p][p]We introduced a Guild system to support Survivor communities and co-op gameplay.[/p][p]While the current version includes only the basics, we’re planning to expand it with exclusive content and activity rewards so that a wide variety of community interactions can flourish.[/p][p]We regret not delivering this earlier, but the team is working hard to bring you meaningful and fun content.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Major Upcoming Content[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Party System Overhaul[/b][/p][p]To enhance the joy of playing together, we’re preparing a complete overhaul of the Party system.[/p][p]The redesigned system will go beyond simple co-op and bring both efficiency and strategic fun to group gameplay.[/p][p]In particular, we’re refining the balance for party play in high-difficulty content to maximize the satisfaction of growth through teamwork and the thrill of challenge.[/p][p]Unique buffs will also be provided during party play to emphasize the value of cooperation.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Expanded Guild Content[/b][/p][p]We’re developing full-fledged guild content to strengthen bonds and teamwork between guild members.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Guild Shelter System[/b][/p][p]Guild Shelters will serve as exclusive spaces where members can gather.[/p][p]Based on guild activity and contributions, facilities can be built and upgraded, providing shared growth opportunities and convenience features.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Guild Conquest Mode[/b][/p][p]We’re introducing Guild Conquest, an 8v8 PvP mode.[/p][p]Inspired by traditional shooter-style conquest battles, this will be a highly strategic competitive mode where teamwork and stronghold control are key.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Episode 2[/b][/p][p]Major narrative developments are also on the horizon.[/p][p]Episode 2 will continue the story after Jimmy finds Linda in Episode 1.[/p][p]Set in the familiar Sand Creek region, new threats, characters, and narratives will emerge, bringing even greater immersion for Survivors.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Combat Skill System Revamp[/b][/p][p]To increase the strategic depth and variety of combat, we’re introducing a new set of active skills.[/p][p]More than ten new PvE- and PvP-focused active skills will be added, offering tactical choices and refreshing your combat experience with new patterns and strategies.[/p][p]Thank you to all the Survivors who’ve been with us over the past 100 days.[/p][p]Every piece of feedback you share serves as motivation and a compass for the dev team in building a better game.[/p][p]We’ll continue listening, communicating, and striving to create a game that’s worth your time.[/p][p]Please keep sharing your thoughts as we work together to create even greater “fun in survival.”[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes July 17
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/7844841adac1b964bcf0bc6922d22f1d761c72a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello, Survivors.[/p][p] [/p][p]We would like to share the patch notes for the version update on Thursday, July 17.[/p][p]Please check the details of this update below.[/p][p]※ Please note that screenshots and images were taken in a test environment, and some changes may occur when applied to the live server.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]■ Version Information[/b][/h3][p]- 0.21.0[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]■ New Content[/b][/h3][p][b]New Growth Content – Survivor Level (~8/28/25)[/b][/p][p]- A new growth system, Survivor Level, is added to further strengthen your character.[/p][p]- Survivor Level will be operated on a seasonal basis. This season will run until August 28 (UTC+0).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/ccd0333eeb9ee2affbe591415923631fbe830ed9.png"][/img][/p][p]- The Survivor Level is displayed below the character level.[/p][p]- Like normal, Survivor Level increases by gaining XP through zombie hunting, securing building safety, completing quests, etc.[/p][p]- In this season, reaching Survivor Level 40/80 grants Liam McCarney exclusive outfits (Survival Challenger Outfit / Survival Tactical Outfit) that your player character can wear.[/p][p]- The Survival Challenger and Survival Tactical Outfits are limited rewards available only during this season.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/7be57c647091016bb58046efc57b1e644541e0a0.png"][/img]- Survivor Skills and Survivor Level will both reset at the end of the season.[/p][p][/p][p]※ XP handling after reaching Character Level 40 before the Survivor Level update[/p][p]- With the Survivor Level update, all accumulated experience gained beyond level 40 up until now will be applied to the current season's Survivor Level.[/p][p]- Any experience gained beyond level 40 that is not applied this season will not carry over to the next season and will be lost.[/p][p]- Please note that depending on their previous progress, existing survivors may start at a level higher than Level 1.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Growth Content – Survivor Skills (~8/28/25)[/b][/p][p]- Survivor Skills are a new growth feature that boosts various character stats such as weapon attack power, knockdown chance, and max HP.[/p][p]- Survivor Skills can be managed in the menu accessed via a new button next to the character level on the Bag screen.[/p][p]- You can activate various Survivor Skills nodes using Survivor Skill Points. The total stat bonuses from activated nodes are displayed on the right.[/p][p]- Clicking an activated node again will deactivate it and return the used Survivor Skill Points.[/p][p]- Survivor Skills and Survivor Level will both reset at the end of the season.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/da8b1514220543728eaae25fc6c4580e4db53bc0.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New System - Guild[/b][/p][p]- A new system, Guild, has been added, allowing you to play together with other survivors.[/p][p]- You can access the guild system from the tablet menu to participate in guild activities, create, or join a guild.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/65f212fdbe7408f3a76425ee1da593c953f43e5c.png"][/img][/p][p]- You can join a guild starting from Character Level 20.[/p][p]  ① You can search for a guild by its name.[/p][p]  ② You can apply to join a guild from the list.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/a07501e3a69a0bcf1ba6c4b9775b5c0512bf9e96.png"][/img][/p][p]- You can create a guild starting from Character Level 20.[/p][p]  ① You can freely customize the guild emblem’s pattern and color.[/p][p]  ② You can set the guild name and a brief introduction.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/7a65612379de74ad8781bd2cc49f446d3aedfe38.png"][/img]- If you are in a guild, you can view your guild information.[/p][p]- Guild leaders have access to the \[Manage Guild] menu to edit guild information.[/p][p]  ① You can donate guild funds to your guild.[/p][p]  ② You can view detailed information about guild members.[/p][p]  ③ A “Leave Guild” button is available in the My Info window.[/p][p]  ④ You can check in to your guild.[/p][p]  ⑤ You can edit the emblem, name, and introduction at any time in the \[Manage Guild] menu.[/p][p]  ⑥ You can set the guild joining method.[/p][p]   ㄴ Open: Players can join the guild freely without the guild leader’s approval.[/p][p]   ㄴ Approval: Players can join the guild after the guild leader approves their request.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/35a53e51fb2a68ff4f68562f0c8ca9c6a4aa6f3c.png"][/img][/p][p]- Depending on the guild level, the total number of guild members can increase from a base of 30 to a maximum of 50.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Resident – Liam McCarney / Community Pass Season 3[/b][/p][p]- Liam McCarney dreamed of becoming a soldier, but suffered setbacks every time due to unexpected accidents that prevented him from taking the exam. However, he never gave up and saved many people from the threat known as Black Hound. Now, with more allies by his side, Liam is leading the charge to protect the shelter with unmatched strength.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/0007036ec079587f1606a76e401a09d552165457.png"][/img][/p][p]- Liam McCarney can be obtained from the newly added Community Pass Season 3.[/p][p]- Upon reaching level 40 of the Community Pass, you can also obtain Liam McCarney’s special outfit.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/92f39b232e8ad81b86e46d405ffda9ca4f4d3aec.png"][/img]- You can find the Community Pass in Shop – Package – Community Pass.[/p][p]- The Community Pass can be purchased once per character.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Event – Starfish Collection Event (~8/28/25)[/b][/p][p]- To celebrate the summer season, the Starfish Collection Event will be held.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/79fc8254441c3b91c2b7f8452d4cd8ac900ab3cc.png"][/img][/p][p]- You can obtain Starfish when defeating zombies in Sand Creek, Bielli Island, Pamrein, Holitore, Twilight Holitore, and Rootland.[/p][p]- The Starfish you acquire can be exchanged for various items including swimsuit armor via Shop – General Goods – Starfish Exchange.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/cf05d737746fb6a7ec61966272913dcff3d74500.png"][/img]- Starfish currency will be removed in bulk after the event ends.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Season 3 New Events (~8/28/25)[/b][/p][p]- A new 7-day attendance event begins.[/p][p]- A new cumulative login event begins.[/p][p]- A new 28-day attendance event begins.[/p][p]　ㄴ Existing Lucky Coupon rewards will be changed to Event Lucky Coupons.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Outfit – Silvermoon Beach Outfit[/b][/p][p]- The new Silvermoon Beach Outfit will be added.[/p][p]- The outfit can be found in Shop – General Goods – Outfit.[/p][p]- The outfit can only be purchased once per character.[/p][p]※ The outfit will appear differently depending on the gender of the character it is equipped on.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/03af4b11bf6f4176e4b2424aa69939cb2c6d2f75.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Pets – White Munchkin, Golden Munchkin[/b][/p][p]- New pets White Munchkin and Golden Munchkin will be added.[/p][p]- The new pets White Munchkin and Golden Munchkin can be found in Shop – Pets.[/p][p]- Each pet can only be purchased once per character.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/3d8c939ea3f40c5c877651e58b8f51d7befe52ca.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Limited-Time Packages – Season 3. Surprise Upgrade Package, Season 3. Advanced Upgrade Package, Season 3. Special Upgrade Package (~8/28/25)[/b][/p][p]- To celebrate Season 3, limited-time packages will be released.[/p][p]- These packages can be found in Shop – Package – Limited-Time Package.[/p][p]- Each package can be purchased 1, 3, and 3 times respectively per character.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Package – Beginner-Only Lucky Package[/b][/p][p]- This package will pop up when the \[Shop] content is unlocked.[/p][p]- It can only be purchased for 3 hours after the pop-up appears.[/p][p]- It can only be purchased once per character.[/p][p]* For survivors who have already unlocked the \[Shop] content, the Beginner-Only Lucky Package will pop up the first time you log in after the update.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Key Improvements[/b][/h3][p]New Feature: Hide Appearance[/p][p]- A new feature to hide hats, bags, and outfits will be added.[/p][p]- A button will be added at the bottom of the Bag screen to toggle hat, bag, and outfit appearance On/Off.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/6dec7794f2c122a5cedde1a0682b1181fdcd0e95.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Support for 6 New Languages[/b][/p][p]- Support will be added for 6 additional languages.[/p][p]- The newly supported languages are German, French, Italian, Russian, Turkish, and Thai.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/b1086011da5f7ba7071848a108e754924a1ed978.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Co-op Raid Improvements[/b][/p][p]- The score earned from defeating zombies other than the boss in co-op raids has been increased.[/p][p]- In co-op raids, raid rewards will now be Upgrade Tool Boxes with random grades (N~SR) instead of fixed-grade Upgrade Tools.[/p][p]- Only successful co-op raids will now count toward your multiplayer ranking score.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/p][p]- Headshot damage against player characters has been adjusted from 2x to 1.5x.[/p][p]- The main stats of some gear have been increased by 10%.[/p][p]  ㄴ SSR-grade ranged weapon attack power increased by 10%.[/p][p]  ㄴ SSR-grade armor defense increased by 10%.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Standard Monthly Membership Improvements[/b][/p][p]- A buff will now be provided upon purchase of the Standard Monthly Membership.[/p][p]- Buff effects provided are as follows:[/p][p]  ● Character XP gain +10%[/p][p]  ● Party Member Resident XP gain +10%[/p][p]  ● Milla gain when killing zombies +10%[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/18bfebaca4d0c383f048e0e661dd390fc1231185.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Shop[/b][/p][p]- The purchase limit for the 1+1 products in Shop – Currency – Red Diamonds will now be notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/015e99361963e498fb4be886e1b40c28f17cd584.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the DARKEST DAYS, Trust No One![/p][p][/p][p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p]This is the server version.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]■ Version Info[/b][/h3][p]- iOS/AOS/PC: 0.20.1[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]■ New Additions[/b][/h3][p][b]New Content – Resident Expedition[/b][/p][p][img Room Level 5, can be entered through the Shelter > Exploration Room[/p][p]- Form an expedition team with your residents and use your vehicles to begin exploring.[/p][p]- The number of residents you takes place on a new board-style map where you can move one tile at a time.[/p][p]- Various events (combat, rewards, buffs) may be available through each tile.[/p][p]- Rewards vary by event and can expedition.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/9033098e19d07196256d1630d78881a84ee1902c.png"][/img][/p][p]- Click ‘End Expedition’ found through Shelter > Exploration Room > Resident proofs required for resident breakthrough, and hard-to-find facility blueprints can be acquired in ‘Twilight Holitore’.[/p][p][img added.[/p][p]- These new items will be obtainable through drops in-game or Pickup Lucky Boxes.[/p][p]- The Hunting-themed armor includes 4 SSR-grade pieces.[/p][p]- The Tommy, known for having a high notes.title: June 5 Korean AMA & Roadmap Update Q&A
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/015e99361963e498fb4be886e1b40c28f17cd584.jpg"][/img]

[b]Q. What happens to EXP after reaching level 40?[/b]
A. EXP will now continue to accumulate beyond level 40.
All EXP previously earned through quests will also accumulate and be applied as well.
An issue that causes EXP values to display as an infinite amount is currently being fixed.

[b]Q. The Community Pass rewards seem to have changed. Can you let us know why?[/b] 
A. Starting this season, the Community Pass has been revamped to offer more variety and themed rewards. The final reward is a skin for the new resident, Kyla Jane. Going forward, we plan to align rewards with each season’s theme.

[b]Q. There seems to be a bug with Kyla Jane's quests.[/b]
A. We’ve identified the issue preventing quest progression and will fix it. Also, some of Kyla Jane’s quests unlock the following day because they are based on in-game time. 

[b]Q. What’s changing in the PVE content?[/b]
A. For survivors who prefer PVE content over PVP, ER can now be earned from PVE activities. Killing Contaminated Flowers, Zombie Hordes, Titans, and Gigas will now reward you with ER.
Also, an ER supply system through the Shelter facilities is in development, and ER acquisition in Rootland has been increased.

[b]Q. The residents block the view too much.[/b]
A. We’ve received a lot of feedback regarding this.
The first phase of improvement patch prevents residents from blocking your line of fire.
In the next update, a “Combat Stance” setting will also be introduced.

[b]Q. Will there be more ways to level up residents?[/b]
A. Yes! A new "Resident Expedition" feature is coming.
You can send residents on expeditions using gas tanks, and they’ll grow through the process.
Now you’ll be able to level-up residents in different ways and not just through hunting or combat manuals.

[b]Q. Reporting abnormal players in Rootland is too inconvenient.[/b]
A. We plan to add a report function that lets you report the opposition directly when your character dies.
We are also continuously strengthening systems to prevent abuse via third-party programs.

[b]Q. Are new guns and armor always OP?[/b]
A. We are focusing on continuously adding distinctive and not overpowered gear.
Each piece of equipment is designed to support specific roles and play styles.

[b]Q. I heard there's going to be a Survivor Level system?[/b]
A. Yes, starting from the June 5 update, a new growth system based on accumulated EXP is being added.
We plan to offer seasonal growth content, and reaching certain levels will unlock cosmetic rewards.

[b]Q. Are guild systems coming too?[/b]
A. Yes, we’re currently developing it!
We’re exploring features like Guild Housing and potential Guild Wars mode (tentative).
Our goal is to enable more group-oriented play.

[b]Q. I’m not happy with the Boss Raid Contribution Scoring system.[/b]
A. Actions like killing zombies and rescuing other survivors will be better reflected in your score.
Also, the reward structure will also be adjusted to reflect these new changes.

[b]Q. What about the skill system revamp?[/b]
A. We’ve received feedback that the current system lacks some uniqueness.
We’re working on a complete overhaul that allows skills to meaningfully change gameplay, and not just add stats.
Details will be shared once this new system is finalized.

[b]Q. Armor feels too weak.[/b]
A. We agree. We've internally acknowledged the low efficiency of armor upgrades and are discussing improvements.

[b]Q. How are you addressing multi-account issues?[/b]
A. We’re actively monitoring multiple accounts connecting from the same device or IP.
Only accounts with clear signs of suspicious activity will be sanctioned, so regular users need not worry.

[b]Q. Will there be an equipment inheritance system?[/b]
A. Currently, there are no plans for this type of system, but we will revisit it at a later time.

[b]Q. Losing all your items upon death in Rootland is quite scary.[/b]
A. Many new players are unintentionally dropping items upon entering Rootland.
We are working on in-game solutions and considering systems like a Safe Box to preserve certain items.
[b]
[/b]Q. When will the weapon balance adjustments happen?
A. Buffs to SSR weapons will come first and then, we plan to rebalance underused weapons like melee, pistols, and others.

[b]Q. Enhancement stress is too high…[/b]
A. We believe the current structure in which growth past level 40 relies heavily on gear is the core issue.
We're introducing the Survivor Level system to provide alternative growth paths.
We also agree that the current enhancement downgrade experience is a bit too harsh and are discussing improvements. However, due to interconnected balance issues, we can’t announce specific changes just yet.

[b]Q. The new resident’s appearance is underwhelming.[/b]
A. We’ll be sure to upgrade the visual quality.

[b]Q. Why can’t residents and players share outfits?[/b]
A. The character models are different, so they can't use the same clothes directly.
However, we plan to introduce NPC outfits that players can unlock through Survivor Level rewards in the future.

[b]Q. Are you doing stealth patches?[/b]
A. Definitely not. All balances and content changes are always announced in advance to the community.

[b]Q. Zombies don’t seem to bite anymore?[/b]
A. The early game had biting and QTE (Quick-time event) to escape, but we removed it as it didn’t fit our current direction.
Now zombies are designed to attack without a grab mechanic.

[b]Q. Shelter facilities don’t feel useful.[/b]
A. We’re adjusting the system values so the benefits of facilities will be more noticeable.

[b]Q. Where can I get blueprints?[/b]
A. Residents over level 20 can obtain blueprints through Expeditions.
They can also be earned through Achievement rewards.
We plan to add more blueprint drops in new content like Holitore Hard and Resident Expeditions.

[b]Q. Can we search by prefix in the marketplace?[/b]
A. Yes, we’re adding a prefix search feature so you can find specific item options more easily.

[b]Q. Push rewards feel too weak.[/b]
A. Starting this season, push rewards will be increased.

[b]Q. How is game security being improved?[/b]
A. As of the June 5 update, the client-side security has been strengthened.
If the game is launched alongside suspicious programs, it may not run.
DARKEST DAYS takes a strict stance against unauthorized software usage.

[b]Q. Are macros allowed?[/b]
A. Macros using external programs are prohibited.
We’re discussing policy on hardware vendor-provided macros and will share details once finalized.

[b]Q. Where can iOS users enter coupons?[/b]
A. Coupons can be redeemed through the official website.

[b]Q. What about other feedback?[/b]
A. We’re reviewing or implementing the following:
- Displaying hidden stats on gear
- Item lock function
- Chat-linked item sharing
- Auto ammo reload
- Bulk repair / Storage features
- Additional zombie types
- Beginner-friendly Rootland matchmaking
- Loot system overhaul (e.g., zombies drop items instantly)
- Improvements to low-level area quests
- Default quantity improvements when moving items to storage
- Skill reset item availability across level milestones[/p]

notes.title: [Update] Wednesday June 4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/015e99361963e498fb4be886e1b40c28f17cd584.jpg"][/img]
In the DARKEST DAYS, Trust No One!

Hello Survivors,
This is the DARKEST DAYS.

Please check below for the detailed patch notes for the update on Wednesyday, 6/4.
※ All screenshots and images were taken in a test environment and may differ from the live server version.


[/p][h3]■ Version Info[/h3][p][b]- iOS/AOS/PC: 0.19.1[/b]


[/p][h3]■ New Additions[/h3][p][b]\[New Resident: Kyla Jane][/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/aa14d963ab5921d03acdfa4e54de9bf2b629fc1c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/2291b804c27fd2336a0e5f0a669535c4a90ee5ec.png"][/img]- Kyla Jane is a legendary Las Vegas gambler and former Miss Universe. With her unmatched beauty and expert sleight of hand, she dominated the gambling scene. After the outbreak, she began to view survival as the ultimate gamble, eventually overcoming crisis after crisis with bold, decisive moves. Refusing to live a dull life even in the post-apocalyptic world, she continues to chase the thrill of high-stakes gamble.

[/p][h3]\[New Events for Season 2 (~25/07/16)][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/e6d3dd3d292bc50375d7000341e3c180b7d6a559.png"][/img]- The 7-Day Login Event for Season 2 updated.
The event will now reset and you will be able to complete it again each time after completing 7-days.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/18f7a82051d0ab165d800cc6a01a3566dee34fab.png"][/img]- A new 28-Day Login Event introduced for Season 2.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/44dc38a3f93efa878a1c0ee41ed03fedc5f5cd7b.png"][/img]- A new Cumulative Login Event introduced for Season 2.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/430b5858462f44d72489d52058b31d6ee29f831f.png"][/img]- A new 7-Day Login New Survivor Event introduced for Season 2.

[b]\[New Products Added][/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/40bcea48e294d755b3e98d5aa39752c89c71cd46.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/9f2d36183736049c2e9b3fb023bcfcf3269426af.png"][/img]- A new Community Pass for Season 2 added.
　ㄴ The rewards for Season 2 will feature a brand-new lineup that differs from Season 1.
　ㄴ The final reward for the new Season Pass will be an exclusive outfit for a new resident.


[/p][h3]■ Key Changes[/h3][p][b]\[Improved EXP Accumulation After Level 40][/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/78ec7850a39a5ea18b93d132e9563d0fa3a97ac5.png"][/img]- The system has been improved to allow EXP to accumulate after your character reaches level 40.
　ㄴ All quest completion EXP earned since reaching level 40 will be retroactively applied.
- A new system that utilizes the accumulated EXP is currently in development, so please stay tuned.

[b]\[ER Drop Sources Added][/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/90d0c6674d8c20904d5e5194aceaed43332b0678.png"][/img]- Titan, Gigas, and zombie hordes above level 36 will now drop ER.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/5954522ddf1907eed2cfdcf6d7dddbb0fa96067f.png"][/img]- Contaminated Flowers will now guarantee drops of SR-grade or higher materials (quantity will vary by level). In addition, level 40 Contaminated Flowers will also drop ER. 

[b]\[Increased ER Drop Rate][/b]
- The drop rate for ER in Rootland increased.

[b]\[Increased Trinity Coin Rewards][/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/e28dfb80f9308ea44d5d14986249e17dcb577382.png"][/img]- Trinity Coin rewards from journals and achievements increased.
　ㄴ Previous: 10 Trinity Coins → Updated: 50 Trinity Coins
ㄴ If you have already completed and claimed rewards from these journals and achievements, the difference will be sent to your mailbox during the maintenance.
- Trinity Coins from Daily Quests also increased.
　ㄴ Previous: 10 Trinity Coins → Updated: 20 Trinity Coins

[b]\[Resident AI Improvements][/b]
- Resident party members will now avoid standing directly in front of the player during combat.
　ㄴ This is the first phase of improvements and further updates are planned.


[/p][h3]■ Improvements[/h3][p][b]\[UI][/b]
- Animation effects to the pop-up when purchasing a membership product added.
- The warning message color in the Resident Combat Manual pop-up has been changed to make it more noticeable.
- Improved the character status pop-up to display a message when no effects are currently applied.
- For player convenience, a button has been added to the tablet UI that takes you directly to the Exploration Room.
- Skill activation effects improved.
- Adjusted the spacing between character portraits and dialogue choices in the NPC conversation windows.
- Icons improved to better distinguish between general enhancement tools and quest items.
- Improved how the Standard and Premium Monthly Memberships are displayed when both are subscribed to simultaneously.
- Items obtainable via options will now be displayed on the map.
[/p][p][b]\[Characters][/b][/p][p]- Vehicle refuel and repair motions have been improved[/p][p]
[b]\[Quests][/b]
- Improved the early game flow by adjusting the difficulty, number of quests, and tutorials in the early stages.

[b]\[Text][/b]
- Descriptions of a resident’s specialized skills updated to be indicated more clearly.

[b]\[Rootland][/b]
- Improved settings so that the grass in Rootland no longer disappears when changing the graphic options.


[/p][h3]■ Fixes[/h3][p][b]\[Visual Effects][/b]
- To ensure smoother gameplay, the cutscenes will no longer play when downloading the Exploration Tower Map.

[b]\[Quests][/b]
- Linda’s weapon durability will no longer decrease during the “Ruin” quest.
- Facility construction-related quests will now appear under the Community category.
- Messages related to facility construction and upgrades will now only be shown once.
- The objective icon will no longer appear for facility upgrade quests.
- Fixed issue where the failure messages for “Emergency Cooperative Training” quest was not displaying properly.
- Fixed issue where Jimmy remained invincible after completing the “Ruin” quest.
- Fixed issue where the indicator did not disappear even after approaching the objective in the “Looking for a Ball Boy!” quest.
- Fixed issue where recommended levels were not displayed for some quests.
- Fixed incorrect descriptions and system messages for certain quest items.
- Reduced the number of zombies in the “Gas Station Attack” quest and fixed an issue where they spawned faster than intended.
- Fixed issue where all zombies were marked as targets in quests requiring the elimination of specific monsters.
- Fixed issue where corpse objects continued to display even after completing the “A Colleague in Danger” quest.
- Fixed issue where followers appearing in quests were hostile towards zombies.
- Fixed issue where receiving Linda after completing the “Ruin” quest caused the barracks to exceed its max capacity.
- Fixed an issue where the “Fresh Zombie Blood” item did not stack correctly.
- Fixed issue where no level penalty was applied when equipping certain quest items that should have a penalty.
- Fixed issue where EXP rewards were not correctly granted for the “About Exploration” quest.

[b]\[UI][/b]
- Loading image when moving to Sand Creek updated.
- Fixed issue where the image aspect ratio in the Journal varied depending on the set resolution.
- Fixed bug where the cursor would become locked if the tablet was closed while the buff pop-up was open in the inventory screen
- Fixed issue where detailed info for zombie hordes did not display properly on the map, or the icon would remain even after defeating the hordes.
- Fixed issue where a scrollbar appeared in the invite chat window.
- Fixed issue where the text in maintenance pop-ups would flow beyond the designated area.
- Fixed issue where the outfit preview checkbox did not appear in the Conflict Zone prep screen in multiplayer mode.
- Fixed issue where enhancement failure values appeared before the visual effects in the Blacksmith.

[b]\[Tutorial][/b]
- The Exchange tutorial will now display properly to ensure smoother use of the marketplace.
- Fixed issue where rapidly tapping during the tutorial progression would cause malfunctions.
- Fixed errors in some tutorial displays.

[b]\[Characters][/b]
- Fixed an occasional issue where guns would appear detached from backpacks when equipped.
- Fixed bug where hair color did not update properly when changing outfits.
- Fixed issue where Luna’s outfit did not display correctly in her character info screen.

[b]\[Monsters][/b]
- Fixed issue where damage was not applied correctly when colliding with Titans or Contaminated Flowers using a vehicle.
- Fixed rare bug on iOS where zombies would remain standing after being killed.
- Adjusted the explosion radius of Rupture when killed.

[b]\[Camera][/b]
- Fixed bug where the camera would lock in place on multiplayer maps.
- Fixed issue where sound incorrectly varied depending on the camera’s position.

[b]\[TAS][/b]
- Fixed bug where the supply drop function unlocked without meeting the required number of activated Exploration Towers.

[b]\[Text][/b]
- Fixed errors in certain system messages.
- Fixed issue where names of the same target in the Location Book were displayed differently.

[b]\[Skills][/b]
- Fixed bug where the “Agility” skill effects did not apply correctly.

[b]\[Items][/b]
- Changed starting equipment to level 5 gear to make it easier to adapt to the game when creating a character.
- Updated icons for Infection Cure Shot S and Defibrillator S for better visual distinction.
- Revised the names and descriptions of general enhancement tools.

[b]\[Buildings][/b]
- Fixed issue where buildings of mismatched levels were found in the Vernen region.

[b]\[Multiplayer][/b]
- Fixed issue where the HUD did not display after entering a multiplayer area or returning to Sand Creek.

[b]\[Rootland][/b]
- Fixed intermittent issue where water effects would appear above the character’s head.
- Fixed overlapping issue between some furniture and objects.

[b]\[Effects][/b]
- Fixed bug where the crafting success rate increase and cost reduction effects from End People community reputation benefits were not being applied.
　ㄴ We apologize for any inconvenience this issue may have caused.
　ㄴ As a token of apology, we will provide all survivors with 2 Lucky Coupons 
     (Available to be claimed until Thu, June 12 02:59 UTC).

[b]\[Shop][/b]
- The “Consumables” tab name has been changed to “General Goods” to better match the category’s purpose.
- The “Special Enhancement Package” has been changed to a permanent sale format.
- Fixed issue where the animation was skipped when rapidly purchasing the Lucky Box once.
- Fixed incorrect slot spacing in the regular package products.
- Fixed issue where detailed information windows for currency items did not display in the purchase pop-up.
- Fixed issue where costumes did not appear on the resident info screen in the Community Pass after viewing resident information in the Recruitment Service shop.

[b]\[Others][/b]
- Mobile app icon updated.
- Latest banned nicknames and chat filter words applied.
- To reduce confusion, character names that have been used once can no longer be reused.
- Fixed issue where the client would crash abnormally or disconnect from the server.
- Fixed disconnection or freezing issues in some mobile environments.
- Fixed issue where some item repurchase prices were set lower than the selling prices during trades with Burns.

Please refer to these latest updates when playing the game.
Thank you.

DARKEST DAYS Team[/p]

notes.title: [Notice] Developer’s Letter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/015e99361963e498fb4be886e1b40c28f17cd584.jpg[/img]

Hello Survivors,

It’s already been a month since we launched the Open Beta.

Both the development team and I are working hard to provide a stable service, but we are aware that there are still many areas that need improvement. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

While writing this letter to our survivors, I looked back through the patch notes from the past month. With that in mind, I would like to share with you what we have accomplished so far and what lies ahead.

[h3]# Auto-Fire Feature for Mobile[/h3]

To reduce the difficulty of controls on mobile, we’ve added an auto-fire feature that allows your character to shoot automatically while aiming.

However, even with this feature, we understand that mobile controls are still challenging. That is why we will continue to improve the mobile gameplay experience and make it one of the top priorities moving forward.

[h3]# Adjusted Respawn Times and Quest Requirements in Multi-Map Areas[/h3]

As survivors grow stronger, moving into multi-map regions becomes inevitable.
However, players often encountered houses that had already been looted, resulting in slow-paced gameplay compared to the fast action in Sand Creek.

To address this, we increased zombie and building respawn rates in multiplayer areas and significantly lowered the difficulty of multiplayer quests.

We hope you’re enjoying the smoother experience in these zones.

[h3]# Community Pass Season Mission Balance and EXP Adjustments[/h3]

The Community Pass previously offered too little EXP compared to the difficulty of the missions. 

To balance this, we have reduced the mission difficulty and increased the EXP rewards.

Future passes will include more exciting rewards and a rebalanced structure to make progression more fun and rewarding.

[h3]# Masked Band Difficulty Adjustment[/h3]

Many survivors struggled with the Community Liberation quests and felt discouraged.
While the Masked Band of Sand Creek is meant to be a formidable enemy, they were, perhaps, a bit too formidable.

In response to this, we have lowered their overall difficulty so the residents of Sandcreek can be freed from torment become your allies and bit quicker.

[h3]# Rootland Difficulty Rework[/h3]

Players have been engaging with Rootland in various ways.  Some are active raiders who attack any survivor they encounter, while others are more stealthy looters who quickly move around and try to avoid conflict.

Early on, zombies and vagabonds (now members of the Masked Band) were so overwhelmingly strong that they seemed to be more of a threat than other survivors.
Some players even mistook vagabonds for cheaters!

To balance this, we have lowered the difficulty of these enemies so that even newly 40-level players can participate in Rootland.

With that being said, we understand that many players still find Rootland and the PvP content intimidating and difficult.

We are currently in the process of making it possible to earn a fair amount of ER in PvE zones as well.

[h3]# Lucky Box Probability and ER Reward Adjustments[/h3]

We revamped the Advanced Lucky Box to improve the overall experience.

Items like SSR-grade equipment were previously too rare, and the ER rewards were often underwhelming.

The drop rates have been adjusted to make opening Advanced Lucky Boxes more worthwhile.

[h3]# Equipment Enhancement Probability Adjustment[/h3]

We received consistent feedback about the difficulty of upgrading high-tier items because of the current enhancement structure. It was also noted that lower-tier items with high upgrades sometimes outperformed rarer ones.

To address this, we have adjusted enhancement rates across the board so all gear grades now share the same success probability.

We hope this alleviates some of the frustration.

Additionally, since gear enhancement was the only meaningful growth path after level 40, we are developing systems that allow continued character progression through gameplay and EXP, not just enhancements.

[h3]# Raid Time Expansion and Repeating Rewards[/h3]

The limited raid windows often conflicted with players’ schedules, and rewards were only given once regardless of success or failure.

We have expanded the entry time zones and now allow for repeat rewards.

Also, with enhancement rebalancing, survivors have become stronger.

We are reviewing raid reward structures to base them on contribution and roles rather than just boss damage. We will share more once those plans are finalized.

[h3]# Holitore Difficulty Adjustment[/h3]

We have heard your feedback about a lack of suitable farming locations after level 40.
To compensate for this, we have adjusted some areas in Holitore to level 45 areas.

We are also continuously reviewing additional high-level PvE zones for after reaching level 40.

While the above changes are part of our core and regular updates, we are also working on improvements for the following issues. While we don’t have exact implementation dates yet, our team is actively preparing the changes outlined below.

[h3]# Mobile Optimization[/h3]

We are focusing on better performance and stability for mobile users.

Optimization efforts are underway to reduce crashes and unresponsiveness and we aim to ensure smooth gameplay across both low-end and high-end devices.

[h3]# High Repair Costs for High-Grade (Especially SSR) Items[/h3]

We recognize the frustration of obtaining high-grade gear but being unable to use it freely due to repair costs. We do not want anyone to have a negative experience of being unable to use your gear even after you worked hard to acquire it.

We plan to significantly reduce repair costs across the board.

All gear grades will now share the same repair cost as N-grade gear of the same level.
This should allow you to enjoy various content without worrying about repair expenses.

[h3]# Performance Differentiation for High-Grade Gear[/h3]

We understand that some upgraded lower-tier items may outperform higher-grade ones.

We are working on gradually increasing the performance of high-grade items to make them more worthwhile.

SSR gear will not just be "one grade higher" than SR.  It will feel significantly more powerful.

We will provide more information on this once the changes are finalized.

[h3]# Additional ER Sources[/h3]

Soon, you’ll be able to earn ER from zombie hordes and titans in Sand Creek and multiplayer zones.

Contaminated Flowers will also be updated to drop higher-tier crafting materials.

[h3]# Additional Hunting Zones Outside Conflict Areas[/h3]

Currently, many players farm in Sand Creek or Holitore after reaching level 40.

However, with limited level-45 zones, the competition can seem intense.

Before new zones are introduced, we are considering upgrades to existing areas to serve as viable high-level hunting grounds.

[h3]# After Level 40 Growth Content[/h3]

Starting next update, players will be able to continue earning EXP beyond level 40.
A UI will allow you to track accumulated EXP, which will later be used to unlock new stat boosts.

Note: This is not a level cap increase but an additional growth system from which you can acquire abilities through EXP.

[h3]# AFK Issues in Multiplayer Content[/h3]

We are preparing a reporting and penalty system for AFK abusers in multiplayer content such as Lonetree Tunnel, raids, and other areas.

Until this system is implemented, we will review repeated reports of unfair and dishonorable behavior and may issue temporary bans for malicious misuse.

[h3]# UI/UX Improvements for New Players[/h3]

Many experienced survivors have been kind enough to guide newcomers and we deeply appreciate your efforts.

We are working on improving the game’s onboarding experience so new players can understand and enjoy the game more intuitively, without needing to ask as many questions.

The improvements directions outlined today will be reflected in the roadmap we’ll announce next week, along with the update schedule.

Thanks to all the feedback you have shared across our communities, we have been able to improve the game step by step.

We know there is still much to do and we are not stopping here with these changes.

Please continue to share your feedback, suggestions, and support.

We remain committed to listening with an open mind and working with you to create a game worth playing.

Thank you.

Darkest Days PD
