notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/015e99361963e498fb4be886e1b40c28f17cd584.jpg[/img]

In the DARKEST DAYS, Trust No One!

Hello Survivors,

Please check below for the detailed patch notes for the update on Thursday, 5/15.
※ All screenshots and images were taken in a test environment and may differ from the live server.


[h3]■ Version Info[/h3]
- iOS/Android/PC: 0.18.6


[h3]■ New Additions[/h3]
[b][New “Auto Fire” Feature for Mobile] [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/147562fbc06b71bd800ef553ac390bf2149516c1.gif[/img]
- To improve the mobile experience, an Auto Fire feature has been added.
- Enable via Settings → Controls → Ranged Assist → Auto Fire.
- Once enabled, aim at a target and maintain the crosshair for a certain duration to fire automatically.
- If the crosshair moves off the target, firing stops.
- Manual firing via the fire button is still possible while Auto Fire is on.
- Available in both Sand Creek and Multiplayer modes


[b][Character “Name Change Ticket” Added][/b]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/eb54067dc9fcec41c37f51d31d016dcea380eb1b.png[/img]
- A new item, the “Name Change Ticket,” has been added to allow changing a character’s name.
- One “Name Change Ticket” will be provided for free.


[b][5 New Costumes Added][/b]
- 5 new costumes replicating outfits worn by NPCs are now available.
- The new costumes can be found in Shop – Consumables – Costumes. More details can be viewed in-game.
　ㄴ Bulletproof Catcher Costume: Worn by Boby of End People
　ㄴ Necktie Fashion Costume: Worn by Elisha White of Medical Support
　ㄴ Special Police Costume: Worn by Aiden Schmidt of First Responders
　ㄴ Firefighter Costume: Worn by Matthew Campbell of Blood Lab
　ㄴ Communications Officer Costume: Worn by Nathan Farmer of Shopaholic

[b][New Products Added][/b]
- New packages: Basic Construction, Barracks Construction, and Special Enhancement Packages 1–3.
　ㄴ Available in Shop → Packages → General Packages.
- ER, Anilium Fragments, and Anilium Crystals added.
　ㄴ Available in Shop → Consumables → Training Tools.
- Purchase limits for Resident Level-Up Packages 1–3 changed from once per character to once per week.


[h2]■ Major Changes[/h2]
[b][Increased Rates for Advanced Lucky Boxes][/b]
[b]- Greatly increased chances of obtaining SR and SSR equipment.[/b]
- Changed probability is as follows.
   ㄴOld: SSR 0.4500%, SR 1.3500%, R 13.5000%, N 74.7000%, No grade 10.0000%
　ㄴ New: [b]SSR 2.2500%, SR 6.7500%[/b], R 13.5000%, N 67.5000%, No grade 10.0000%
- Lucky Coupons will be issued for all Advanced Lucky Box purchases made from Global Beta launch up until this update on 5/15 (Thurs).
　ㄴ e.g., [b]During the target period, a total of 100 Advanced Lucky Box draws ▶ Provide 100 Lucky Coupons[/b]
- Normal Lucky Box rates remain unchanged.

[b][Increased Equipment Enhancement Success Rates][/b]
[b]- Enhancement success rates now unified across all rarities and overall increased:[/b]
　ㄴ Old: Enhancement probability varies by N~SSR-grade
　ㄴ [b]New: All grades of enhancement probability adjusted at once (same as the existing N-grade enhancement probability)[/b]
- After the update, the equipment enhancement probability is as follows.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/2155673c0bea1fb7ec4378cb467bdf80731104b7.png[/img]
- As the probability of enhancing equipment of R-grade or higher has changed significantly, we will provide the goods used to enhance equipment of R-grade or higher that have been enhanced since the global open beta and before the update maintenance on 5/15 (Thu).
　ㄴ e.g., [b]If you enhance R-grade equipment a total of 10 times and enhance SSR-equipment once during the target period > All enhancing tools, ER, and Milla consumed for enhancing R-grade equipment 10 times and enhancing SSR-equipment once will be provided.[/b]

[b][Co-op Raid Reward System Overhaul][/b]
[b]- Changed the success/failure rewards for the 37th Street Construction Site and Dusk Garden to be received repeatedly.[/b]
- Previously, rewards could only be received once a day regardless of success/failure, but now rewards can be received for each co-op raid you participate in.
- Since repeated receipts are now possible, the balance of rewards paid upon success has been partially changed.
- The changed success rewards are as follows:
ㄴ Construction Site on the 37th provides armor enhancement tools, and Dusk Garden provides weapon enhancement tools.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/6c51f18e0648287ceb904b8eff6509e6cff530cc.png[/img]


[h3]■ Improvements[/h3]
[b][Community Pass Icon Added on Tablet][/b]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/f7f6e5189280266002417a87ec4b7403f5554827.png[/img]
- Community Pass is now accessible directly from the tablet UI.

[b][Zombie Health Bar Color Change][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/e77cc8c824ae6cfdb9276d4cb1e4b668a7003f2c.png[/img]
- The color of the zombie health bar has been changed to be more intuitively distinguishable from the health bar of the residents.

[b][Other][/b]
- Improved so that system messages are displayed for each distance step in quests that fail depending on distance.
- Improved so that the background image is displayed in the pet menu even when you do not have a pet.
- Improved UI spacing in the NPC dialogue window.


[h3]■ Other Adjustments[/h3]
[b][Help][/b]
- Added missing and new Help entries.

[b][Objects][/b]
- Adjusted object sizes in Sniper Training.

[b][UI Target][/b]
- Adjusted pet tutorial target location in UI.

[b][Products][/b]
- Enhanced descriptions for Limited Firearm and Advanced Firearm Packages.

[b][Quest][/b]
- Zombies in “Kill Remaining Zombies” quests no longer cluster unnaturally.
- Updated “Looking for a Ball Boy!” quest to guide via proximity indicator.

[b][Balance][/b]
- The pet function has been changed to be unlocked after completing the 'Talk to Light' quest.
- The exchange function has been changed to be unlocked after reaching level 15.
- The number of free recovery times for lost equipment has been increased, and the recovery cost has been reduced.
- The appearance of Vagabonds appearing in Rootland has been changed to match the Masked Band appearance, and the balance has been adjusted downward (they are weaker now).
- Wood is no longer required to craft Anilium pieces and crystals.


[h3]■ Bug Fixes[/h3]
[b][Character][/b]
- Fixed an issue where female player characters would play as male character motions.

[b][UI Target][/b]
- Fixed an issue where the ‘Resident Breakthrough’ tutorial during the Resident Management quest would not proceed properly.
- Fixed an issue where the UI target was incorrectly displayed on the HUD minimap on PC.

[b][UI][/b]
- Fixed an issue where the Resident Personality Effect pop-up would not close when the tablet was closed.
- Fixed an issue where the equipment icon equipped by the player would blink when an NPC shot a gun.
- Fixed an issue where the UI for the area information download pop-up would not display properly on mobile.
- Fixed an issue where the interaction button would continue to display even after quickly descending from a ladder and moving away from the ladder.
- Fixed an issue where translation was not applied to the Collector’s Guide registration pop-up window.
- Fixed an issue where zombie horde information was not displayed properly when selecting the zombie horde icon on the map.

[b][Product][/b]
- Fixed an issue where the UI would not immediately update when reaching the maximum level of the Community Pass.
- Fixed an issue where the price in the store was displayed as 0 and payment did not proceed normally.
- Fixed an issue where the equipment prefix displayed in the probability display of the Lucky Box appeared to be fixed.

[b][Cutscenes][/b]
- Fixed an issue where the camera would show the wrong place during a cutscene or while playing.
- Fixed an issue where the subtitles for some cutscenes were out of sync and line breaks were incorrectly applied.
- Fixed an issue where sound effects were not output properly in some cutscenes.

[b][Quests][/b]
- Fixed an issue where the target building would intermittently be secured immediately during the 'Entry Test' quest.
- Fixed an issue where Den would not appear or would not be able to proceed during the 'Suspicious Barrier' quest.
- Fixed an issue where quest items could be obtained in areas other than the target area in the 'Restaurant Expansion Project' quest.
- Fixed an issue where it was impossible to interact with the target object in the 'Looking for Ball Boys!' quest.
- Fixed an issue where the quest would not be completed even if the 'Psychopath Girl' and 'Ultimate Wine Ingredients' quest objectives, the cooperative raid, were cleared.

[b][Items][/b]
- Fixed an issue where the defense and enhancement probability of the R-grade garter belt pants were incorrectly applied.

[b][Friends][/b]
- Fixed an issue where existing search results were displayed when searching for friends in Add Friends.
- Fixed an issue where friends were displayed in duplicate in the Friends list.

[b][Trade][/b]
- Fixed an issue where the product list and product initialization prices in the Burns Store were not updated immediately.

[b][Background][/b]
- Fixed an issue where objects or backgrounds were not displayed properly.
- Fixed an issue where some buildings could not be entered properly in multi-regions.

[b][Exchange][/b]

[b][Facility][/b]

[b][Exploration][/b]

[b][Optimization][/b]

[h3]■ Known Issues[/h3]

notes.title: [Notice] DAY 1 – Developer Letter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/015e99361963e498fb4be886e1b40c28f17cd584.jpg[/img]

Hello Survivors, this is the DARKEST DAYS team.

We’re thrilled to have met so many survivors through the recently launched Open Beta! While there are still areas for improvement, we’re committed to polishing the game and responding to all your valuable feedback. We truly appreciate your support. 

To kick things off, here are the issues that have been fixed, as well as those we are currently working on:

[h2]Known Issues & Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Disconnections During Multiplayer (In Progress)[/h3]
Many survivors may have experienced this issue on Biel Island.
We have identified the cause and are currently working on a fix. We will update everyone once it has been applied!

[h3]Shelter Management Quest Not Progressing (Fixed)[/h3]
This issue has been resolved and players should now be able to progress normally.

[h3]Barracks Upgrade Material Issues & Resident Reactivation (Fixed)[/h3]
When the barracks were still at Level 1, if a player accidentally deactivated a resident, they could not be reactivated due to a lack of available beds.
In addition, materials for upgrading the barracks were difficult to obtain, making it hard to activate additional residents.
To fix this, we’ve removed material requirements to upgrade barracks from Lv.1 to Lv.2
We've also sent a bundle of wood to your mailbox as an apology for the inconvenience caused in finding materials!

[h2]Live Stream Q&A Highlights[/h2]
We also began hosting 100 days of daily live streams and gathered some key questions from yesterday’s stream: 

[b]Q1. I’m getting a message saying “Account already linked to a third party” and can’t link my account.[/b]
A: This means a different character is already registered under your account. Please contact customer support and we’ll help you delete the unused character so you can link properly.
In the future, you’ll be able to choose the character you want to link directly.

[b]Q2. I repaired my car, but the damaged door didn’t get fixed.[/b]
A: Repair kits only restore a portion of the damage. Severely damaged vehicles may need multiple repair kits.

[b]Q3. I keep getting disconnected while playing on Biel Island.[/b]
A: We’ve identified the issue and are working on a fix! We’ll update you once it has been applied.

[b]Q4. I accidentally deactivated Oliver and now I can’t take him with me.[/b]
A: We’re updating the game so that the first barracks upgrade (Lv. 1 > Lv. 2) can be done immediately. You’ll now be able to upgrade to Lv.2 without needing to search for wood.

[b]Q5. How can I delete my character?[/b]
A: To prevent accidental or unauthorized deletions (such as through hacking), deleted characters go through a 7-day grace period.
If you want to delete a character to link accounts between mobile and Steam, please contact customer support and we’ll help you out as quickly as possible.

[b]Q6. I want to change my nickname, so I’m trying to delete my character. Can you sell a nickname change item?[/b]
A: Currently, we don’t support nickname changes, but we are considering adding this feature in the future.

[b]Q7. Is this a P2W (Pay-to-Win) game?[/b]
A: With the exception of a few items in the Community Pass (like Luna Bloody and pets), all gear and growth materials can be earned through gameplay (looting, crafting, quest rewards, etc.).
There are currently no exclusive paid weapons or armor that are only available in the shop.
From the beginning, our development team has avoided creating a P2W experience and focused on allowing players to enjoy the game at their own pace.
That said, we understand that some of the limited-time items may have come across differently, especially for those with less time to play, and for that, we apologize. 

Overall, we apologize if some of you were left with a negative first impression of the game. We hope you’ll continue to follow the game as we grow and improve it in the future.

DARKEST DAYS Team.

notes.title: [Notice] DARKEST DAYS Cross-Platform Usage Guide (Account Linking Instructions)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/b546ec2e5db191ad2938a3ef4e4bf5c0bbc7efcb.jpg[/img]

DARKEST DAYS supports cross-platform play between PC and mobile, 
allowing Survivors to enjoy the game conveniently anytime, anywhere.

Please refer to the guide below to ensure smooth cross-platform play.
※ Please note that account linking for cross-platform play is only possible on mobile devices.


[h3]PC(Steam) → Mobile Play: If you want to use the same account you played on Steam on your mobile devices[/h3]

[b]1. On the intro screen, click ‘Sign in with Steam’[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/198839fc8aec3f3c659dd80086bf4fe95dddf478.png[/img]
- On your mobile device, click ‘Sign in with Steam’ to access the game.

[b]2. Use your existing account as is[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/afb8fbbbb064eab6be7b093d4a2af7e2c761e1d0.png[/img]
- You can continue to play on mobile using the same account you used on PC(Steam).


[h3]PC(Steam) → Mobile Linking: If you want to link the account you used on Steam to a different platform account on mobile[/h3]

[b]1. On the intro screen, click ‘Sign in with Steam’[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/198839fc8aec3f3c659dd80086bf4fe95dddf478.png[/img]
- On your mobile device, click ‘Sign in with Steam’ to access the game.

[b]2. In the game, go to Settings → Account menu[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/829585f03652f614ec16ac6933e793440106d60f.png[/img]
- You can link your account from this menu.
- Since you are currently logged in with a PC(Steam) account, the account is displayed as ‘Linked’.
- You can link your account by clicking the ‘Link’ button with the account you want, either Apple or Google.
Or you can link both Apple and Google accounts.

[b]3. Linking completed with your preferred account among Apple and Google[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/a536926822d389b1081bbb39378a4f3e1bad9034.png[/img]
- In the example above, both Apple and Google accounts have been linked and are now in the ‘Linked’ status.
- You can continue playing with the same account on all platforms where linking is complete.


[h3]Mobile → PC(Steam) Linking: If you want to transfer an account you played on mobile to Steam[/h3]
※ If you want to transfer an account you played on mobile to Steam, linking is only possible if you have never played DARKEST DAYS on Steam (have never created an account).
※ If you already have an account on Steam but need to link, we will guide you through the linking method 1:1 through the Customer Center.

[b]1. On the intro screen, click ‘Apple’ or ‘Google’[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/f23dd9f2d151b4e63cce64fd3d01faf06acb1c00.png[/img]
- Click ‘Sign in with Apple’ or ‘Sign in with Google’ on your mobile device to access the game.
※ Guest accounts have a risk of being lost, so we recommend using them after linking your account to a platform such as Apple, Google, or Steam.

[b]2. In the game, go to Settings → Account menu[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/d032766c1421929f1a9ab19404e73419f1e490ac.png[/img]
- You can link your account from this menu.
- In the example above, since you logged in with a Google account, the account is displayed as ‘linked’.
- To play on PC(Steam), click the ‘Link’ button for your Steam account to proceed with account linking.

[b]3. Linking completed with the Steam account[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/57b123311f8fbc312a6c193ab015f0003c7e50c0.png[/img]
- Steam account linking has been completed and the status has been changed to ‘Linked’.
- Now you can use the account you were playing on mobile on PC(Steam).

[b]4. Sign in with Steam[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/afb8fbbbb064eab6be7b093d4a2af7e2c761e1d0.png[/img]
- On PC(Steam), if you have a Steam account, you can access the game right away without a separate login procedure within the game.
- If account linking is complete, you can continue playing on PC(Steam) with the account you were using on mobile as above.


[h3]Unlinking Your Account[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/4512e1d6444b162c9b4ada93ef5dec1944063512.png[/img]
- You can unlink your account as shown above by clicking the ‘Linked’ button.
- If you want to link to a different account than the linked account, please use the menu above.


Please check the cross-play usage guide provided above,
and enjoy DARKEST DAYS more comfortably.

Thank you.

DARKEST DAYS Team

Survive the horrors of Sand Creek with a loyal companion by your side! Pets aren’t just cute, they come with unique abilities that help you scavenge for supplies.

Introducing Luna Bloody, a competitive and diligent new survivor.

Once a teen American Kendo Champion, Luna now wields her sword to protect herself and those around her. Her drive and strength make her a powerful ally in your fight for survival.

notes.title: [Notice] Developer Q&A
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/c505de387cc2dd1de72001a92b15881e3003bc12.png[/img]

Hello, Survivors.

First, we want to express our gratitude for the overwhelming response to our recent demo. We've received a wide range of feedback, and our team has been carefully reviewing your thoughts and questions.
To address some of the most frequently asked topics, we've gathered responses from our developers. Check them out below!


[h3][b]Q1.  How long will it take to complete the development of the game?[/b][/h3]
A2 The DARKEST DAYS team is committed to improving the gameplay experience based on feedback from the recent Steam Next Fest. We're excited to return with the Open Beta Test (OBT) at the end of April!
Our focus will be on refining the game further based on player feedback during OBT. Once we’re confident that DARKEST DAYS delivers the best possible experience for all survivors, we will announce the official release date. Stay tuned!

[h3][b]Q2. Questions about various Language Support?[/b][/h3]
A2. Based on feedback from demo participants, our development team is considering adding support for French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Thai, and more. This is in addition to languages already supported during the Steam Next Fest.
We’re excited to welcome survivors from around the world and will continue expanding language support to make DARKEST DAYS more accessible to everyone.

[h3][b]Q3. From the Demo experience, the gameplay was mainly single-player. Are there any plans to make it co-op in the future?[/b][/h3]
A3. The Co-op defense mode (Lonetree Tunnel) and Co-op raid mode (Dusk Garden) were designed with long-term expansion in mind. What players experienced during the Steam Next Fest was just a small preview.
We plan to introduce new maps and a variety of bosses with unique mechanics to keep survivors engaged with fresh challenges.
Additionally, we are actively developing strategic Guild content for members to enjoy together. Stay tuned for more details in the future!

[h3][b]Q4. Are there any plans to further optimize performance for more devices?[/b][/h3]
A4. Optimization is a top priority for our development team, and we are continuously working to improve it. We will keep monitoring performance to ensure players can enjoy DARKEST DAYS smoothly.

[b][h3]Q5. Are there any games that were used as inspiration for DARKEST DAYS?[/h3][/b]
A5. We drew inspiration from various games during the development of DARKEST DAYS. As many survivors have noted, State of Decay was a key influence in shaping zombie behavior and interaction mechanics.
Our development team consists of passionate gamers who have played and created various shooter genres, including State of Decay, Borderlands, Fallout, The Division, and PUBG.
While these games have influenced us, we are dedicated to ensuring that DARKEST DAYS stands out with its own unique identity.

[h3][b]Q6. I enjoy driving in games and enjoy the ability to be able to drive my vehicle "off-road" in DARKEST DAYS. Are there any plans to allow players access to more vehicles and the ability to upgrade them? If so, what will access to vehicles and upgrades look like?[/b][/h3]
A6. Vehicle upgrades can be performed at the Parking Facility in the Shelter using the Vehicle Enhancement Tool.
Materials needed for upgrades can be collected through various in-game activities, allowing survivors to enhance their vehicles for greater speed, durability, and overall survival efficiency in the apocalyptic world.
Upgrading vehicles will serve as another key progression goal, and we plan to continue adding new vehicles to give Survivors even more options.

[h3][b]Q7. Is there going to be a clan system, where I can enjoy with friends?[/b][/h3]
A7. We are developing a Guild system to foster stronger bonds and enhance strategic gameplay. This feature will allow survivors to create a Guild with friends or join an existing one, offering deeper and more cooperative gameplay experiences.
As the Guild system is still in development, we can’t share all the details just yet. Stay tuned for more updates in the future!

[h3][b]Q8. Is this game more focused on Action or Survival?[/b][/h3]
A8. We believe that both action and survival are essential elements of DARKEST DAYS. Rather than prioritizing one over the other, we aim to balance both to ensure an engaging and exciting experience.
DARKEST DAYS is designed to offer continuous growth for players, rather than fitting into a single genre. We want survivors to develop their in-game skills alongside their character’s progression.
Our overall goal is to create a game that is easy to pick up yet deeply immersive, allowing players of all skill levels to enjoy the experience.

[h3][b]Q9. Are there any plans to further improve the game assets and immersion?[/b][/h3]
A9. With cross-play support, our top priority is ensuring seamless visuals across both PC and Mobile platforms.
To enhance immersion, our art team is continuously refining the game's environments for greater realism. This includes implementing natural shadows and adjusting color temperatures based on weather changes, improving light reflection on materials, and enhancing environmental effects like dust, fog, and dynamic background elements.
We hope to create a visually immersive world that feels alive, no matter which platform you play on.

[h3][b]Q10. Is the Military Tank going to be obtainable? What other vehicles will we have access to?[/b][/h3]
A10. While there are no tank-type vehicles planned at the moment, we're always considering how to introduce a variety of vehicles that suit the new regions, environments, and concepts in future updates.
In addition to standard vehicles, we're working on unique concept vehicles, such as off-road cars built for racing down the hills of Sand Creek and sports cars that will be challenging to drive in the apocalypse.
Stay tuned for these exciting additions in the future! 


For more updates and discussions, be sure to check out our official Discord channel.

[h3][b]■ Discord[/b][/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/MuUnPKK6Wf]Click here to join our Discord[/url]

Thank you for your support!

DARKEST DAYS Team

A. The Global Test is open to everyone. Please install the DARKEST DAYS Demo from Steam and enjoy the game.

[b]Q: Will I be able to continue playing with my character after the Global Test?[/b]
A: All account data will be deleted after the testing period. You will not be able to continue playing with your game demo progress in the future.

[b]Q: Are there purchases available during the Global Test?[/b]
A: There will not be any items available for purchase during the testing period. The store will however be functioning and items can be purchased with resources obtained through normal gameplay.

[b]Q: How do I link my account so I can play on other platforms?[/b]
A: DARKEST DAYS supports login options via Google/Apple/Guest. To play on different platforms you will need to link your account with either Google/Apple. If you created a Guest account, you can link your account from within the in-game settings.

[b][How to link account when logged in as Guest][/b]
- Account linking can be done through the in-game Tablet Menu -> Settings -> Account Menu
　※ Note that all DARKEST DAYS account data will be deleted after the testing period.
　※ The Tablet Menu can be accessed via the methods shown below.
- For PC, this menu can be accessed by pressing “ESC” on your keyboard.
　※ If a character is created through Guest Login on PC, you will not be able to continue playing with the same character on mobile.

[b]Q: Why is my game not running smoothly?[/b]
A: If your game is not running properly, please check the following:

1. Check to make sure you meet the minimum spec requirements:
[b][Minimum Specs][/b]
- CPU: Intel i5 3570 / AMD FX 8350
- Memory: 8GB RAM
- GPU: GeForce GTX 1050ti / AMD Radeon RX 570
- Storage: 20GB
[b][Recommend Specs][/b]
- CPU: Intel i7 7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
- Memory: 16GB RAM
- GPU: GeForce GTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600XT
- Storage: 20GB
2. Try adjusting the game’s graphic settings.
Graphic settings can be adjusted by going to the Tablet Menu -> Settings -> Graphics
3. Try reinstalling the game to ensure no corrupted files are inhibiting your gameplay experience.

[b]Q: How can I login with a different account?[/b]
A: You can log out through the in-game settings and log back in with a different account.
1. From in-game go to the Tablet Menu -> Settings -> Account -> Title Screen
2. Select the Account icon located in the upper right corner and login.

[b]Q: How can I delete my account?[/b]
A: Please refer to the following steps on how to delete your account:
1. From in-game go to the Tablet Menu -> Settings -> Account.
2. Select “Delete Account”

[b]Q: How can I report bugs?[/b]
A: DARKEST DAYS is still currently in development and unexpected bugs may occur. We apologize in advance for any bugs experienced.
To report any bugs, you can do so by going to the link below:
https://hangame-mobile-private.oc.nhncloud.com/ddeng/hc/


[b]Q: Why aren’t there any more available quests?[/b]
A: This Global Test being conducted was set to deliver the core gameplay ahead of the full-scale OBT slated for the end of March. As such, this Global Test will have limited content available.
The content available during the Global Test are:
Single Player Mode (Sand Creek): Story Quests up to level 20.
Even after completing all single player quests, you can continue to enjoy other modes such as Lonetree, Bielli Island, and Dusk Garden.

[b]Q: When will multiplayer mode be available to play?[/b]
A: During the Global Test period, multiplayer modes will be available. Check the below to see when each mode is unlocked.
During this Global Test, only certain multiplayer modes are available.

[b][Lonetree Tunnel][/b]
- Up to 4 Survivors cooperate to defend against oncoming zombies.
- After reaching level 9, you can gain access by completing the quest “Dangerous Lonetree Tunnel”.

[b][Dusk Garden][/b]
- Cooperate with other Survivors to defeat bosses and obtain rewards.
- Reach level 13, and complete quests “Something Big” and “Dangerous Lonetree Tunnel”.
- Check the available Dusk Garden participation times daily.

[b][Bielli Island][/b]
- Supply farming and multiplayer mode.
- Reach level 20 or complete the quest “Behind the Wall”.
- Unlocked once “Tragedy on Bielli Island” and “Dangerous Lonetree Tunnel” is completed. 
　※  Because of the short duration of this Global Test, the requirements to enter each of the modes have been lowered as described so more players can participate in them. Please note that these conditions may be different for the official launch later.

[b][How to Enter Multiplayer Mode][/b]
In-game Table Menu -> Other Areas -> Select Desired Mode -> Enter.

[b]Q: How do I change my character information?[/b]
A: Once a character is created, altering the character’s appearance is not possible. If you wish to change your character’s appearance, you will need to delete the character and create a new one.

[b][How to Delete a Character][/b]
1) Tablet Menu -> Settings -> Account -> Title Screen
2) Select the character deletion icon
　※ Please note you can only create one character at a time.

[b]Q: I found a user who is abusing the game, what should I do?[/b]
A: The DARKEST DAYS team will use the data collected through this Global Test to ensure that users can continue to have an enjoyable gaming experience in the future.
Users who are using cheats, inappropriate language, or other abusive behaviors are prohibited. 
Please submit a report with the link below:
https://hangame-mobile-private.oc.nhncloud.com/ddeng/hc


[b]Q: Where can I find the game’s Terms of Use?[/b]
A: DARKEST DAYS game Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, and personal information collection/use consent form can be found at the link below.

- Terms of Use: https://accounts.hangame.com/terms/mobile/toastTermAgreeGlobal

- Privacy Policy: https://darkestdays.cdn.toastoven.net/license/2025021718/PRIVACY_TERM_AGREE_EN.html


DARKEST DAYS Team
